text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (January 18, 2024) for 1196 Yonge Street.

Confirmed Items 1, 2, 4 and 6 of the Property Standards Order (January 18, 2024) for 1196 Yonge Street, Folder Number: 24 106041 PRS 00 IV, and in doing so grant an extension of time to September 6, 2024.
